label: External character-aligned third person
camera_rules: Camera remains outside all characters and has an explicit physical position.
Movement names a start relation, path, speed, subject relation, and landing composition.
The focal character guides attention without granting the camera hidden knowledge.
continuity_rules: Preserve axis side or declare a motivated crossing and re-establishing shot.
Carry screen direction, eyelines, prop ownership, and body state across cuts.
Use only coverage shots that perform distinct visible functions.
knowledge_policy: Reveal only information available to the focal character unless the scene explicitly selects objective or omniscient focalization.
